signals.summary: MITRE laid off 442 employees, about 4.9% of its workforce, mostly at its Tysons, Virginia headquarters, citing lost or canceled contracts.
MITRE's federal contracts were canceled, including work for the IRS, DHS and NIH, amid federal contract reductions.
MITRE states it is actively hiring across cybersecurity, AI/ML, health, space and systems engineering areas.
